crossRefs.note: The Philistine said, “I defy the armies of Israel today! Give me a man, that we may fight together!”
David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, “What shall be done to the man who kills this Philistine, and takes…
Your servant struck both the lion and the bear. This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, since he has…
Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against…
and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

parallels.note: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.

people.name: David

people.name: Israel

people.name: Jonadab

people.name: Shimeah
